{{Quotation|game|Relics of a mysterious race, possibly an offshoot of the [[Deldrimor]] [[dwarf|dwarves]], have been uncovered in this productive jade mine. Though not as large or strategically vital as the enormous [[The Jade Quarry (Luxon)|Jade Quarry]], the Aurios Mines are of great importance to historians and scholars.}}

[[The Aurios Mines (outpost)|The Aurios Mines]] is a mine located deep within [[the Jade Sea]]. It is besieged by the [[Nightmare Horde]], the minions of [[Kanaxai]].

== Getting there ==
Enter Rhea's Crater from [[Seafarer's Rest]] and head east through the southern passage to reach the Aurios Mines.
